body:
Founder real-time cluster: 'choosing a texture for a material from the textures interface doesnt work it just defaults to the brick look' + 'can we make the characters stuff work outside of story mode? story mode as we know it will be like half life where it just starts and you can save on whatever level you are on... theres no way for me to test the story mode unless we were to build a level select interface... which is what the levels menu already is.' Texture fix (IDUNA/NOCK frontend): a material's own texture_id was never actually applied anywhere -- not just the native client (a real, separate, already-documented limitation: proc_tex.c has no image decoder) but the NOCK editor's own web preview either, which only ever used a wall's flat r/g/b color regardless of texture assignment. New applyWallTexture loads the real image via the texture library and applies it as the wall material's diffuse map when the resolved material has a texture_id, restoring r/g/b tint otherwise. Wired into root walls and embedded-object content walls (S479c) for consistency; also fixed a real, minor texture-map GPU resource leak on rebuild. Characters fix (SHANKPIT native): server_apply_custom_level's character-spawning was hard-gated to MODE_STORY/MODE_STORY_CAVE for a real safety reason -- the full story_ai_reset it called deactivates every player slot, which would disconnect real connected humans if it ran during a live MODE_QUEUE round. New story_ai_despawn_all_characters deactivates ONLY the specific slots g_story_ai itself spawned into (via each AIController's own player_id), leaving every other slot (human or queue-bot) untouched -- used outside MODE_STORY instead of the full reset. Live-verified: a synthetic level with one authored character, loaded in default DEATHMATCH mode, produces CUSTOM_LEVEL_CHARACTERS_SPAWNED count=1 in the server log. make server/make lobby clean. Named, deliberate scope limit: the lobby's own direct level-select path doesn't yet call the character-spawning wrapper (works via the S477-broadened exit-transition path already, just not a direct level pick). Also discussed, not yet built: the founder's broader ask that STORY MODE become an ordinary level flagged 'is_story_start' (which already exists) with a real fade-from-black/gaussian-blur/title-card intro sequence, replacing the legacy hardcoded un-editable VOXWORLD story level entirely -- routed to backlog for a real scoping pass, not attempted in this cluster given its own real size. Commits: SHANKPIT d98e741 (characters fix) + 605fb81 (changelog); IDUNA e1f191e (texture fix) + cc27f4b (dist). Deployed live (iduna.service restarted; shank_server rebuilt but NOT yet redeployed to the live shankpit-server.service -- needs the same founder go-ahead already established this session for that live-player-facing restart).

⚓ ☃
title: S480: characters work outside MODE_STORY + materials texture picker actually renders
